document.title: MSU-L20S15-07 Test Primer A8100 and Chemicals E100B-006 cleaning of C-MG/S-MG/Yoke/PT
document.purpose: Test Primer A8100, Chemicals E100B-006 and Ethanol cleaning for C-MG, S-MG, Yoke, PT (vs ethanol baseline).
content: Tension Long SM / Short SM / C-MG

conclusions.normalized_interpretation: All three cleaners (Primer / Chemicals / Ethanol) give 0/6 decap NG on B-PT+S-MG, MG+PT, YOKE+CM. Within the 80-90% / 70-80% spec gates.

Long SM: Primer 48.07 vs Normal 36.89 = +30.3%; Chemicals 46.57 = +26.2%. Short SM: Primer 30.08 vs 28.50 = +5.5%; Chemicals 25.21 = -11.5%. C-MG: Primer 165.46 vs Normal 185.64 = -10.9%; Chemicals 170.61 = -8.1%. Primer slightly stronger overall.

conclusions.statement_from_report: Function and Drop test final sample all OK.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Primer 2.83% vs Normal 1.10% = 2.575x, 157.5% worse; Chemicals 2.15% vs 1.10% = 1.957x, 95.7% worse. Both worse than ethanol baseline but author considers acceptable; report ends with CAN USE.
Author approves Primer A8100 and Chemicals E100B-006 for the full cleaning chain (C-MG, S-MG, Yoke, PT). Note: function NG slightly worse than ethanol - monitor in mass production.

troubleshooting_index.defect_name: Cleaning agent selection for C-MG / S-MG / Yoke / PT

suggested_checks.check_item: Adopt Primer A8100 or Chemicals E100B-006 as cleaning option (full chain)
suggested_checks.reason: Decap, tension, drop test all pass; author approves CAN USE.

suggested_checks.check_item: Monitor function Hearing NG when using Primer / Chemicals

limitations: Decap sample 6 pcs, function 91-106 pcs, single event.

assumptions: Treated Ethanol cleaning as Normal/baseline as per the original 'BRS-201506' alcohol-baseline practice.
warnings: C-MG tension lower than ethanol by 8-11% even though decap passes - monitor in mass production.
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Same-event Normal (Ethanol) row present. Primer/Chemicals show pass on decap/tension/drop; function NG slightly worse than baseline. Author decision = CAN USE; this differs from earlier '45.L20S15-07' DooJin VN-coated yoke trial which decap-failed.
